<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/orders/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

The customer-ordering order, plus its tracking under tracking and, when the cookie's last checkout placed this order, the checkout totals under totals. Tracking and totals are best effort and absent when their upstream fails; the order itself is required. The order and tracking bodies are relayed with every field, including each group's optional promise window timeZone.
